lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A second heartbeat prowls beneath the shrine bells. Vampira follows it because hunger recognizes hunger.

lines.speaker: VAMPIRA
lines.text: Come closer, NEKOMATA. I prefer my nightmares warm.

lines.speaker: NEKOMATA
lines.text: Try to keep up, VAMPIRA. I have lives to spare.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nekomata laughs through the pain. “You are less boring than the dead ones.”

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A voice without lungs fills the cathedral. Vampira discovers there are hungers blood cannot answer.

lines.speaker: VAMPIRA
lines.text: Come closer, BANSHEE. I prefer my nightmares warm.

lines.speaker: BANSHEE
lines.text: Listen carefully, VAMPIRA. The next sound is for you.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The song breaks into silence, but the silence remembers her name.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: At the heart of Nightbloom waits a queen whose stare has outlived empires.

lines.speaker: VAMPIRA
lines.text: Come closer, MEDUSA. I prefer my nightmares warm.

lines.speaker: MEDUSA
lines.text: Look at me when I end this, VAMPIRA.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Stone cracks. The Red Moon chooses appetite over eternity.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A paper seal flaps in the harbor wind. Something dead beneath it has been waiting for the Red Moon.

lines.speaker: VAMPIRA
lines.text: Come closer, JIANGSHI. I prefer my nightmares warm.

lines.speaker: JIANGSHI
lines.text: Seal intact. Target: VAMPIRA. Proceeding.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The seal chars at the edges. Vampira tastes thunder where blood should be.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A pale reflection appears in every dark window of the library. None of them belong to Vampira.

lines.speaker: VAMPIRA
lines.text: Come closer, YUREI. I prefer my nightmares warm.

lines.speaker: YUREI
lines.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, VAMPIRA.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The books close themselves. Something remains standing between the words.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Hoofbeats arrive without a horse in sight. Dullahan carries her own head and a lance aimed at the first thirst.

lines.speaker: VAMPIRA
lines.text: Come closer, DULLAHAN. I prefer my nightmares warm.

lines.speaker: DULLAHAN
lines.text: Choose a road, VAMPIRA. I will meet you at the end of it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: For once, Vampira is not the only woman carrying hunger separately from her heart.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The horizon brightens. A wolf-woman waits where the Red Moon is dying, furious that night is ending before the hunt does.

lines.speaker: VAMPIRA
lines.text: Come closer, WEREWOLF. I prefer my nightmares warm.

lines.speaker: WEREWOLF
lines.text: Run if you want, VAMPIRA. It improves the hunt.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Dawn arrives smelling of iron, roses, and wet fur.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The wrapped queen smells like dust, resin, and a heartbeat that stopped centuries ago.

lines.speaker: VAMPIRA
lines.text: Come closer, MUMMY. I prefer my nightmares warm.

lines.speaker: MUMMY
lines.text: Stand still, VAMPIRA. The wrappings work better that way.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Vampira discovers curses have an aftertaste.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Witch has prepared six circles. Vampira steps into all of them on purpose.

lines.speaker: VAMPIRA
lines.text: Come closer, WITCH. I prefer my nightmares warm.

lines.speaker: WITCH
lines.text: Careful, VAMPIRA. You are standing inside the spell already.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The library gains a new rule: never invite a vampire into a ritual.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Vampira stands beneath a sunrise she was never meant to see. The Red Moon has withdrawn, but its taste remains in every shadow. She smiles—not because the night survived, but because hunger did.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A ghost-song steals every small sound from the shrine bells. Nekomata takes that personally.

lines.speaker: NEKOMATA
lines.text: Try to keep up, BANSHEE. I have lives to spare.

lines.speaker: BANSHEE
lines.text: Listen carefully, NEKOMATA. The next sound is for you.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The last note becomes a purr in the dark.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Every snake watches both tails. Nekomata grins at the impossible amount of attention.

lines.speaker: NEKOMATA
lines.text: Try to keep up, MEDUSA. I have lives to spare.

lines.speaker: MEDUSA
lines.text: Look at me when I end this, NEKOMATA.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The snakes learn that curiosity is contagious.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The tournament closes around two predators who refuse to become prey.

lines.speaker: NEKOMATA
lines.text: Try to keep up, VAMPIRA. I have lives to spare.

lines.speaker: VAMPIRA
lines.text: Come closer, NEKOMATA. I prefer my nightmares warm.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nekomata lands on her feet. Of course she does.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The harbor corpse hops in perfect rhythm. Nekomata immediately decides the rhythm is wrong.

lines.speaker: NEKOMATA
lines.text: Try to keep up, JIANGSHI. I have lives to spare.

lines.speaker: JIANGSHI
lines.text: Seal intact. Target: NEKOMATA. Proceeding.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A bell rings once. Two tails answer twice.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nekomata notices the same ghost watching from six different shelves. Finally, a worthy stalking game.

lines.speaker: NEKOMATA
lines.text: Try to keep up, YUREI. I have lives to spare.

lines.speaker: YUREI
lines.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, NEKOMATA.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The ghost fades. One tail is still pointing at where she went.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Dullahan removes her head. Nekomata immediately forgets this is supposed to be frightening.

lines.speaker: NEKOMATA
lines.text: Try to keep up, DULLAHAN. I have lives to spare.

lines.speaker: DULLAHAN
lines.text: Choose a road, NEKOMATA. I will meet you at the end of it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The head returns with two new scratches and absolutely no explanation.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The first sunlight finds two predators pretending they are not enjoying this far too much.

lines.speaker: NEKOMATA
lines.text: Try to keep up, WEREWOLF. I have lives to spare.

lines.speaker: WEREWOLF
lines.text: Run if you want, NEKOMATA. It improves the hunt.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nekomata decides eight lives is still a comfortable margin.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nekomata immediately wants to pull the loose bandage. Mummy immediately regrets everything.

lines.speaker: NEKOMATA
lines.text: Try to keep up, MUMMY. I have lives to spare.

lines.speaker: MUMMY
lines.text: Stand still, NEKOMATA. The wrappings work better that way.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Two tails leave carrying one stolen strip of ancient linen.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Witch draws a perfect sigil. Nekomata sits directly in the middle of it.

lines.speaker: NEKOMATA
lines.text: Try to keep up, WITCH. I have lives to spare.

lines.speaker: WITCH
lines.text: Careful, NEKOMATA. You are standing inside the spell already.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The spell works. The cat simply refuses to acknowledge that.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nekomata watches dawn split into two reflections across the shrine pond. One tail curls toward home. The other points toward whatever impossible thing comes next.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Banshee sings into the moonlit bamboo. Something with a thousand eyes answers.

lines.speaker: BANSHEE
lines.text: Listen carefully, MEDUSA. The next sound is for you.

lines.speaker: MEDUSA
lines.text: Look at me when I end this, BANSHEE.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The gaze breaks before the voice does.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Vampira offers immortality. Banshee already knows what forever costs.

lines.speaker: BANSHEE
lines.text: Listen carefully, VAMPIRA. The next sound is for you.

lines.speaker: VAMPIRA
lines.text: Come closer, BANSHEE. I prefer my nightmares warm.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The cathedral windows tremble long after the fight ends.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Two tails trace the rhythm of a song that should have died centuries ago.

lines.speaker: BANSHEE
lines.text: Listen carefully, NEKOMATA. The next sound is for you.

lines.speaker: NEKOMATA
lines.text: Try to keep up, BANSHEE. I have lives to spare.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: For one moment, the dead and the living share the same chorus.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Banshee finds an opponent with no breath, no pulse, and still somehow too much silence.

lines.speaker: BANSHEE
lines.text: Listen carefully, JIANGSHI. The next sound is for you.

lines.speaker: JIANGSHI
lines.text: Seal intact. Target: BANSHEE. Proceeding.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The talisman trembles to a note only the dead can hear.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The library gives Banshee an echo before she sings. Yūrei is already inside the answer.

lines.speaker: BANSHEE
lines.text: Listen carefully, YUREI. The next sound is for you.

lines.speaker: YUREI
lines.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, BANSHEE.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: For once, silence and song agree on who won.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Banshee sings across the bonefield. Somewhere in the fog, a severed head smiles back.

lines.speaker: BANSHEE
lines.text: Listen carefully, DULLAHAN. The next sound is for you.

lines.speaker: DULLAHAN
lines.text: Choose a road, BANSHEE. I will meet you at the end of it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The rider leaves before the last note finishes. Her head stays to listen.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The horizon answers Banshee with a howl that refuses to be background noise.

lines.speaker: BANSHEE
lines.text: Listen carefully, WEREWOLF. The next sound is for you.

lines.speaker: WEREWOLF
lines.text: Run if you want, BANSHEE. It improves the hunt.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: For one impossible second, howl and wail become harmony.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Banshee sings to a corpse that has already been mourned by civilizations.

lines.speaker: BANSHEE
lines.text: Listen carefully, MUMMY. The next sound is for you.

lines.speaker: MUMMY
lines.text: Stand still, BANSHEE. The wrappings work better that way.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The wrappings vibrate with a melody older than the grave.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Witch reads an incantation. Banshee answers with a note that edits the punctuation.

lines.speaker: BANSHEE
lines.text: Listen carefully, WITCH. The next sound is for you.

lines.speaker: WITCH
lines.text: Careful, BANSHEE. You are standing inside the spell already.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Several books quietly reclassify screaming as grammar.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Banshee sings one final note into the morning. This time, the world answers instead of echoing. For the first time in centuries, her song belongs to the living as much as the dead.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Vampira refuses to avert her eyes. Medusa finds the arrogance refreshing.

lines.speaker: MEDUSA
lines.text: Look at me when I end this, VAMPIRA.

lines.speaker: VAMPIRA
lines.text: Come closer, MEDUSA. I prefer my nightmares warm.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The blood queen learns that statues can bleed when they fall.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nekomata keeps appearing where Medusa is not looking. The snakes begin arguing about it.

lines.speaker: MEDUSA
lines.text: Look at me when I end this, NEKOMATA.

lines.speaker: NEKOMATA
lines.text: Try to keep up, MEDUSA. I have lives to spare.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Even a gorgon can lose track of nine lives.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The challenger cannot be petrified by fear; she has already survived death.

lines.speaker: MEDUSA
lines.text: Look at me when I end this, BANSHEE.

lines.speaker: BANSHEE
lines.text: Listen carefully, MEDUSA. The next sound is for you.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The stone garden remembers the final note.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A talisman forbids the corpse from looking away. Medusa considers that an invitation.

lines.speaker: MEDUSA
lines.text: Look at me when I end this, JIANGSHI.

lines.speaker: JIANGSHI
lines.text: Seal intact. Target: MEDUSA. Proceeding.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The paper survives the gaze. The corpse beneath it does not.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Medusa can petrify flesh. Yūrei has brought very little flesh to the argument.

lines.speaker: MEDUSA
lines.text: Look at me when I end this, YUREI.

lines.speaker: YUREI
lines.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, MEDUSA.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A cracked mirror is the only witness willing to look back.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Medusa orders Dullahan to face her. The rider lifts her head in one hand and politely complies.

lines.speaker: MEDUSA
lines.text: Look at me when I end this, DULLAHAN.

lines.speaker: DULLAHAN
lines.text: Choose a road, MEDUSA. I will meet you at the end of it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Even the snakes cannot decide which pair of eyes won.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Werewolf refuses to lower her eyes. Medusa refuses to admit that makes the fight interesting.

lines.speaker: MEDUSA
lines.text: Look at me when I end this, WEREWOLF.

lines.speaker: WEREWOLF
lines.text: Run if you want, MEDUSA. It improves the hunt.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The snakes learn exactly how fast a wolf can move before sunrise.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Mummy has no reason to blink. Medusa considers that rude.

lines.speaker: MEDUSA
lines.text: Look at me when I end this, MUMMY.

lines.speaker: MUMMY
lines.text: Stand still, MEDUSA. The wrappings work better that way.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The curse survives the gaze. The linen does not enjoy the experience.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Witch has drawn a ward against sight. The snakes take that personally.

lines.speaker: MEDUSA
lines.text: Look at me when I end this, WITCH.

lines.speaker: WITCH
lines.text: Careful, MEDUSA. You are standing inside the spell already.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Every sigil ends the fight facing the wrong direction.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Medusa walks through a garden of statues warmed by sunrise. Hair-serpents blink at the light. Nothing turns away. She decides eternity may be tolerable if it can still surprise her.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The harbor fog carries a song. Jiangshi has no lungs with which to answer, so her talisman answers instead.

lines.speaker: JIANGSHI
lines.text: Seal intact. Target: BANSHEE. Proceeding.

lines.speaker: BANSHEE
lines.text: Listen carefully, JIANGSHI. The next sound is for you.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The dead woman bows. The ghost bows back.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nekomata circles the paper seal like a toy. Jiangshi remains perfectly still until she does not.

lines.speaker: JIANGSHI
lines.text: Seal intact. Target: NEKOMATA. Proceeding.

lines.speaker: NEKOMATA
lines.text: Try to keep up, JIANGSHI. I have lives to spare.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: One hop lands where nine lives were certain she could not.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Medusa commands her to look away. The seal contains no such instruction.

lines.speaker: JIANGSHI
lines.text: Seal intact. Target: MEDUSA. Proceeding.

lines.speaker: MEDUSA
lines.text: Look at me when I end this, JIANGSHI.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Stone dust settles on yellow paper.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Vampira discovers a body with no heartbeat and no intention of surrendering.

lines.speaker: JIANGSHI
lines.text: Seal intact. Target: VAMPIRA. Proceeding.

lines.speaker: VAMPIRA
lines.text: Come closer, JIANGSHI. I prefer my nightmares warm.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: For the first time tonight, hunger has nothing to drink.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The talisman knows how to restrain a corpse. It has no instructions for a ghost.

lines.speaker: JIANGSHI
lines.text: Seal intact. Target: YUREI. Proceeding.

lines.speaker: YUREI
lines.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, JIANGSHI.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Jiangshi pins one corner of the veil to the floor. The rest keeps moving.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: One corpse is sealed. The other misplaced her head. Neither sees a problem.

lines.speaker: JIANGSHI
lines.text: Seal intact. Target: DULLAHAN. Proceeding.

lines.speaker: DULLAHAN
lines.text: Choose a road, JIANGSHI. I will meet you at the end of it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The bonefield receives another perfectly formal bow.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The moon is fading, but something feral is getting stronger. Jiangshi hops forward anyway.

lines.speaker: JIANGSHI
lines.text: Seal intact. Target: WEREWOLF. Proceeding.

lines.speaker: WEREWOLF
lines.text: Run if you want, JIANGSHI. It improves the hunt.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The talisman survives with claw marks through three characters.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: One corpse is held together by paper. The other prefers linen. Neither comments.

lines.speaker: JIANGSHI
lines.text: Seal intact. Target: MUMMY. Proceeding.

lines.speaker: MUMMY
lines.text: Stand still, JIANGSHI. The wrappings work better that way.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Ancient funerary traditions agree to disagree.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Witch wants to know whether the forehead seal counts as a spell component.

lines.speaker: JIANGSHI
lines.text: Seal intact. Target: WITCH. Proceeding.

lines.speaker: WITCH
lines.text: Careful, JIANGSHI. You are standing inside the spell already.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Jiangshi declines peer review with both feet.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Jiangshi reaches the edge of dawn and stops. Her talisman flutters once, then lies still. The seal remains intact—but now it feels less like a prison and more like a choice.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Jiangshi arrives carrying rules for the dead. Yūrei has forgotten how to obey them.

lines.speaker: YUREI
lines.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, JIANGSHI.

lines.speaker: JIANGSHI
lines.text: Seal intact. Target: YUREI. Proceeding.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The talisman falls through an empty sleeve.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Banshee sings across the harbor. Yūrei answers from inside the sound.

lines.speaker: YUREI
lines.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, BANSHEE.

lines.speaker: BANSHEE
lines.text: Listen carefully, YUREI. The next sound is for you.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The final echo belongs to neither woman.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nekomata can track anything that moves. Yūrei decides not to move in ways that count.

lines.speaker: YUREI
lines.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, NEKOMATA.

lines.speaker: NEKOMATA
lines.text: Try to keep up, YUREI. I have lives to spare.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: For once, the cat watches an empty doorway first.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Medusa commands the ghost to meet her gaze. Yūrei has spent centuries looking through walls.

lines.speaker: YUREI
lines.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, MEDUSA.

lines.speaker: MEDUSA
lines.text: Look at me when I end this, YUREI.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The snakes hiss at a reflection that refuses to become stone.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: At the last bell, first blood faces the woman who has none.

lines.speaker: YUREI
lines.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, VAMPIRA.

lines.speaker: VAMPIRA
lines.text: Come closer, YUREI. I prefer my nightmares warm.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The Red Moon shines through Yūrei. Dawn does not.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Dullahan rides toward every place Yūrei is not. Eventually the ghost decides to be somewhere.

lines.speaker: YUREI
lines.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, DULLAHAN.

lines.speaker: DULLAHAN
lines.text: Choose a road, YUREI. I will meet you at the end of it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The head whispers a road name no living map remembers.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Werewolf smells what is not there. Yūrei realizes invisibility is less useful against a nose.

lines.speaker: YUREI
lines.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, WEREWOLF.

lines.speaker: WEREWOLF
lines.text: Run if you want, YUREI. It improves the hunt.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The ghost leaves no footprints. The wolf follows anyway.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Mummy curses what she can name. Yūrei has been avoiding names for centuries.

lines.speaker: YUREI
lines.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, MUMMY.

lines.speaker: MUMMY
lines.text: Stand still, YUREI. The wrappings work better that way.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The curse lands on a reflection and refuses to leave.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Witch seals every exit. Yūrei arrives from inside the chalk line.

lines.speaker: YUREI
lines.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, WITCH.

lines.speaker: WITCH
lines.text: Careful, YUREI. You are standing inside the spell already.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The grimoire adds a margin note: ghosts cheat.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Yūrei fades with the last violet edge of night, then reappears in the reflection of morning glass. Dawn cannot exorcise a memory that has learned its own name.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The rider follows a road that only dead women can see. Yūrei is standing in the intersection.

lines.speaker: DULLAHAN
lines.text: Choose a road, YUREI. I will meet you at the end of it.

lines.speaker: YUREI
lines.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, DULLAHAN.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: For once, Dullahan asks her head which direction the ghost went.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The harbor offers a corpse that moves without breath. Dullahan respects the professionalism.

lines.speaker: DULLAHAN
lines.text: Choose a road, JIANGSHI. I will meet you at the end of it.

lines.speaker: JIANGSHI
lines.text: Seal intact. Target: DULLAHAN. Proceeding.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Two dead women depart in opposite directions without ever saying goodbye.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Banshee hears hoofbeats in her own voice. Dullahan hears a road in the scream.

lines.speaker: DULLAHAN
lines.text: Choose a road, BANSHEE. I will meet you at the end of it.

lines.speaker: BANSHEE
lines.text: Listen carefully, DULLAHAN. The next sound is for you.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The bones vibrate after both women stop moving.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Medusa has never fought someone who can choose which hand holds her eyes.

lines.speaker: DULLAHAN
lines.text: Choose a road, MEDUSA. I will meet you at the end of it.

lines.speaker: MEDUSA
lines.text: Look at me when I end this, DULLAHAN.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The snakes spend the rest of the night checking behind themselves.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Dullahan throws her head exactly once. Nekomata interprets this as the beginning of a game.

lines.speaker: DULLAHAN
lines.text: Choose a road, NEKOMATA. I will meet you at the end of it.

lines.speaker: NEKOMATA
lines.text: Try to keep up, DULLAHAN. I have lives to spare.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The shrine receives a new rule: no playing fetch with cursed nobility.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: At the final bell, a rider without a pulse faces a hunger without an ending.

lines.speaker: DULLAHAN
lines.text: Choose a road, VAMPIRA. I will meet you at the end of it.

lines.speaker: VAMPIRA
lines.text: Come closer, DULLAHAN. I prefer my nightmares warm.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Dawn finds the road empty except for one set of hoofprints and one laughing head.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Dullahan hears claws on stone behind her. She smiles, lifts her lance, and turns the road into an arena.

lines.speaker: DULLAHAN
lines.text: Choose a road, WEREWOLF. I will meet you at the end of it.

lines.speaker: WEREWOLF
lines.text: Run if you want, DULLAHAN. It improves the hunt.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: One set of hoofbeats and one set of pawprints vanish into dawn.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: One warrior carries her head. The other carries several civilizations of burial protocol.

lines.speaker: DULLAHAN
lines.text: Choose a road, MUMMY. I will meet you at the end of it.

lines.speaker: MUMMY
lines.text: Stand still, DULLAHAN. The wrappings work better that way.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The bonefield receives no useful etiquette guidance.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Witch asks Dullahan to place something personal in the circle. Dullahan places her head.

lines.speaker: DULLAHAN
lines.text: Choose a road, WITCH. I will meet you at the end of it.

lines.speaker: WITCH
lines.text: Careful, DULLAHAN. You are standing inside the spell already.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The ritual becomes much less academic.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Dullahan rides directly into sunrise with her head tucked under one arm. The road does not end. It merely becomes visible.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The headless rider smells like iron, grave soil, and a road that never ends. Werewolf follows all three.

lines.speaker: WEREWOLF
lines.text: Run if you want, DULLAHAN. It improves the hunt.

lines.speaker: DULLAHAN
lines.text: Choose a road, WEREWOLF. I will meet you at the end of it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The thrown head bites back. Werewolf approves.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The library is full of old paper and one scent that keeps vanishing through walls.

lines.speaker: WEREWOLF
lines.text: Run if you want, YUREI. It improves the hunt.

lines.speaker: YUREI
lines.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, WEREWOLF.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Yūrei learns that a hunter can follow fear even when fear has no pulse.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Jiangshi does not run. She hops. Werewolf considers this inefficient and therefore offensive.

lines.speaker: WEREWOLF
lines.text: Run if you want, JIANGSHI. It improves the hunt.

lines.speaker: JIANGSHI
lines.text: Seal intact. Target: WEREWOLF. Proceeding.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The dock has claw marks exactly one hop apart.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A scream rolls across the shrine. Werewolf answers with one of her own.

lines.speaker: WEREWOLF
lines.text: Run if you want, BANSHEE. It improves the hunt.

lines.speaker: BANSHEE
lines.text: Listen carefully, WEREWOLF. The next sound is for you.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Every lantern goes dark at the same time.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Medusa tells the wolf to kneel. The wolf has never been especially trainable.

lines.speaker: WEREWOLF
lines.text: Run if you want, MEDUSA. It improves the hunt.

lines.speaker: MEDUSA
lines.text: Look at me when I end this, WEREWOLF.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Several snakes require a long and embarrassing recovery.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Two hunters circle each other beneath the last useful piece of moon.

lines.speaker: WEREWOLF
lines.text: Run if you want, NEKOMATA. It improves the hunt.

lines.speaker: NEKOMATA
lines.text: Try to keep up, WEREWOLF. I have lives to spare.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nobody admits who chased whom.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Night is almost gone. Two creatures built for darkness decide which one gets the final minute.

lines.speaker: WEREWOLF
lines.text: Run if you want, VAMPIRA. It improves the hunt.

lines.speaker: VAMPIRA
lines.text: Come closer, WEREWOLF. I prefer my nightmares warm.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The sun rises on a battlefield that still smells like the Red Moon.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Werewolf can smell the curse before she sees the wrappings.

lines.speaker: WEREWOLF
lines.text: Run if you want, MUMMY. It improves the hunt.

lines.speaker: MUMMY
lines.text: Stand still, WEREWOLF. The wrappings work better that way.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The bandages acquire an alarming number of ventilation holes.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Witch has a spell for beasts. Werewolf has never respected categories.

lines.speaker: WEREWOLF
lines.text: Run if you want, WITCH. It improves the hunt.

lines.speaker: WITCH
lines.text: Careful, WEREWOLF. You are standing inside the spell already.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The circle breaks exactly where the claws said it would.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Werewolf watches the moon vanish and discovers the hunt does not. Daylight only gives the world fewer places to hide.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Witch wants to study the funerary curse. Mummy wants fewer graduate students touching her things.

lines.speaker: MUMMY
lines.text: Stand still, WITCH. The wrappings work better that way.

lines.speaker: WITCH
lines.text: Careful, MUMMY. You are standing inside the spell already.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The grimoire develops a permanent scarab-shaped stain.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Werewolf smells a tomb and decides the wrapping paper is optional.

lines.speaker: MUMMY
lines.text: Stand still, WEREWOLF. The wrappings work better that way.

lines.speaker: WEREWOLF
lines.text: Run if you want, MUMMY. It improves the hunt.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Mummy adds “wolves” to an extremely old list of pests.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Dullahan asks where the head is supposed to go. Mummy refuses to answer on principle.

lines.speaker: MUMMY
lines.text: Stand still, DULLAHAN. The wrappings work better that way.

lines.speaker: DULLAHAN
lines.text: Choose a road, MUMMY. I will meet you at the end of it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Neither funeral tradition wins, but both become significantly messier.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The curse requires a name. The ghost offers none.

lines.speaker: MUMMY
lines.text: Stand still, YUREI. The wrappings work better that way.

lines.speaker: YUREI
lines.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, MUMMY.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Mummy writes the missing name in dust and waits.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Two preserved corpses meet beneath harbor fog. Archaeology immediately becomes dangerous.

lines.speaker: MUMMY
lines.text: Stand still, JIANGSHI. The wrappings work better that way.

lines.speaker: JIANGSHI
lines.text: Seal intact. Target: MUMMY. Proceeding.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The talisman now has a matching strip of linen tied around it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Banshee sings into a body built to outlast mourning.

lines.speaker: MUMMY
lines.text: Stand still, BANSHEE. The wrappings work better that way.

lines.speaker: BANSHEE
lines.text: Listen carefully, MUMMY. The next sound is for you.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: One line of linen loosens to the rhythm.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Medusa expects fear. Mummy has been looking at death for too long to be impressed.

lines.speaker: MUMMY
lines.text: Stand still, MEDUSA. The wrappings work better that way.

lines.speaker: MEDUSA
lines.text: Look at me when I end this, MUMMY.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Several wrappings become statues. The rest keep moving.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nekomata has already pulled the loose end before the warning finishes.

lines.speaker: MUMMY
lines.text: Stand still, NEKOMATA. The wrappings work better that way.

lines.speaker: NEKOMATA
lines.text: Try to keep up, MUMMY. I have lives to spare.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The shrine gains several hundred meters of extremely annoyed linen.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: At sunrise, first thirst faces a queen preserved before half the world had names.

lines.speaker: MUMMY
lines.text: Stand still, VAMPIRA. The wrappings work better that way.

lines.speaker: VAMPIRA
lines.text: Come closer, MUMMY. I prefer my nightmares warm.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Dawn warms the tomb dust. The curse does not fade.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Mummy enters dawn carrying nine new curses and one old name. Sunlight warms the wrappings. Nothing turns to dust. Somewhere beneath the linen, she laughs.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Witch asks permission to examine the curse. Mummy says no. Witch begins taking notes anyway.

lines.speaker: WITCH
lines.text: Careful, MUMMY. You are standing inside the spell already.

lines.speaker: MUMMY
lines.text: Stand still, WITCH. The wrappings work better that way.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The notes survive. The desk does not.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The moon is part of the formula. Unfortunately, so are the teeth.

lines.speaker: WITCH
lines.text: Careful, WEREWOLF. You are standing inside the spell already.

lines.speaker: WEREWOLF
lines.text: Run if you want, WITCH. It improves the hunt.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Witch crosses out “obedient familiar” and writes “absolutely not.”

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Dullahan offers the ritual exactly one head and refuses to specify where it came from.

lines.speaker: WITCH
lines.text: Careful, DULLAHAN. You are standing inside the spell already.

lines.speaker: DULLAHAN
lines.text: Choose a road, WITCH. I will meet you at the end of it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The spell works, technically, which is somehow worse.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Witch seals the room. Yūrei arrives from inside the book.

lines.speaker: WITCH
lines.text: Careful, YUREI. You are standing inside the spell already.

lines.speaker: YUREI
lines.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, WITCH.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The grimoire now contains one page that cannot be turned.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Witch recognizes the talisman as magic. Jiangshi recognizes the wand as a problem.

lines.speaker: WITCH
lines.text: Careful, JIANGSHI. You are standing inside the spell already.

lines.speaker: JIANGSHI
lines.text: Seal intact. Target: WITCH. Proceeding.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Both forms of paperwork are damaged beyond repair.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Witch needs one clean syllable. Banshee gives her an entire impossible chord.

lines.speaker: WITCH
lines.text: Careful, BANSHEE. You are standing inside the spell already.

lines.speaker: BANSHEE
lines.text: Listen carefully, WITCH. The next sound is for you.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Three sigils shatter from the harmony alone.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The ward is perfect. Medusa has more eyes than the ward budgeted for.

lines.speaker: WITCH
lines.text: Careful, MEDUSA. You are standing inside the spell already.

lines.speaker: MEDUSA
lines.text: Look at me when I end this, WITCH.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Witch revises the diagram while dodging snakes.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nekomata sits on the summoning mark and refuses to move.

lines.speaker: WITCH
lines.text: Careful, NEKOMATA. You are standing inside the spell already.

lines.speaker: NEKOMATA
lines.text: Try to keep up, WITCH. I have lives to spare.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The spell summons exactly one annoyed cat, which was already there.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: At sunrise, Witch faces the oldest hunger in the tournament and opens to a blank page.

lines.speaker: WITCH
lines.text: Careful, VAMPIRA. You are standing inside the spell already.

lines.speaker: VAMPIRA
lines.text: Come closer, WITCH. I prefer my nightmares warm.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The first line written under daylight reads: “Nightbloom continues.”

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Witch closes her grimoire as sunrise turns every sigil pale gold. The universe remains stubbornly intact, which means there is still plenty left to rewrite.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A silver thread leads Arachne to VAMPIRA. Each guardian holds a knot in the spell binding a stranger beneath the library.

lines.speaker: ARACHNE
lines.text: Struggle if you like, VAMPIRA. The silk remembers.

lines.speaker: VAMPIRA
lines.text: Come closer, ARACHNE. I prefer my nightmares warm.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Another knot loosens. Beyond VAMPIRA, Arachne follows the trembling thread toward the library.

lines.text: A silver thread leads Arachne to MUMMY. Each guardian holds a knot in the spell binding a stranger beneath the library.

lines.speaker: ARACHNE
lines.text: Struggle if you like, MUMMY. The silk remembers.

lines.speaker: MUMMY
lines.text: Stand still, ARACHNE. The wrappings work better that way.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Another knot loosens. Beyond MUMMY, Arachne follows the trembling thread toward the library.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Witch guards a locked chamber beneath the library. Behind its door, silver strings tremble around a porcelain prisoner. Arachne demands the key.

lines.speaker: ARACHNE
lines.text: Struggle if you like, WITCH. The silk remembers.

lines.speaker: WITCH
lines.text: Careful, ARACHNE. You are standing inside the spell already.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The grimoire falls open. Arachne descends the stairs, carrying a blade fine enough to cut a curse.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Arachne gathers the last thread of the Red Moon. Beneath the library she finds a porcelain woman suspended by silver strings. For the first time, the widow makes a web to set someone free. One strand snaps. Then another. The doll opens her eyes.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The Living Doll returns to the workshop. Witch insists a creation must obey its maker. The doll closes the door behind her.

lines.speaker: LIVING DOLL
lines.text: Watch closely, WITCH. Nobody is moving me.

lines.speaker: WITCH
lines.text: Careful, LIVING DOLL. You are standing inside the spell already.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A crack remains in the porcelain. The Living Doll leaves it there. It is proof the choice was hers.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: MUMMY waits on the road to dawn. The Living Doll chooses to face her, with no hand pulling the strings.

lines.speaker: LIVING DOLL

lines.text: Stand still, LIVING DOLL. The wrappings work better that way.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The horizon brightens. For the first time, she walks without listening for a command.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: At dawn, the Living Doll reaches for strings that are no longer there. Her maker is gone, her porcelain is cracked, and her next step belongs entirely to her. She leaves a silver needle on the library steps. Arachne will understand.
